name: FastAPI (fastapi-pagination)
description: A hand-written Python API. Unlike the others this is a convention, not a specification — FastAPI imposes no shape, so adjust the paths and param names to the actual service.
notes: NOT YET VERIFIED — and cannot be in general: FastAPI is a framework, so every service differs. This encodes the most common convention: fastapi-pagination's Page[T] response, plain query-param filters, and /resource/{id} detail routes.
Assumes the response envelope { items, total, page, size, pages }. A service returning a bare list needs itemsPath removed and total.from set to none.
Filters are plain equality (?make=Toyota). For a partial match the service must expose its own param, e.g. ?plate__contains= — change the filter's `param` and `value` accordingly.

A by-id route usually 404s for a missing record, which the default notFound already handles. If the path can also 404 when misconfigured, prefer a filtered list operation with match.emptyArray instead — see spec §9.1.
